name: print-social-photography-story-black-grey-asymmetric-blocks-orange-frame
title: 'Photography' story with asymmetric black-grey blocks and a rotated orange outline frame
whatItIs: A vertical story split into four asymmetric black and grey rectangular blocks, with a rotated orange outline square overlapping the centre holding a vertical 'PHOTOGRAPHY' label, and small dot-grid and menu icons in the bottom corner.
whatItMeans: Minimal and editorial; asymmetric grey blocks and one rotated frame feel like a gallery composition rather than a typical template.
techniques: Divide a canvas into uneven asymmetric colour blocks.
Overlay a rotated outline frame as the focal label.
Keep type vertical and minimal for an editorial feel.

vocabulary.definition: A composition of unevenly sized rectangular sections.
An angled unfilled rectangle used as a label container.
